hints.title: Alphabet Character State Array
hints.text: Track the length of the longest ideal subsequence ending at each lowercase character from 'a' to 'z'.

hints.title: Allowed Character Window
hints.text: For character ch, look at all valid predecessor characters prev such that |ord(ch) - ord(prev)| <= k.

hints.title: State Update
hints.text: Update dp[ch] to 1 plus the maximum dp value among all valid predecessor characters.

hints.title: Alphabet Array Dynamic Programming Implementation

complexity.notes: Alphabet size is fixed at 26 characters.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Standard longest subsequence DP compares all pairs in O(n^2).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Fixed size 26 array eliminates spatial overhead.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognizes that the subsequence predecessor condition only depends on alphabet ending characters.
